jobs.title: Produktionsplaner – Laminat- und Verbundwerkstofffertigung 80 - 100 % (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
The Opportunity Join our dynamic team in Klingnau, where we specialize in world-class, high-precision plastics manufacturing. As a key player in sectors such as energy, rail, aerospace, industrial services, and more, we pride ourselves on delivering tailored, reliable, and innovative solutions to our global customers. Our success is driven by a collaborative team culture, streamlined decision-making, and a strong focus on automation and process optimization. We're constantly evolving to meet the demands of a fast-paced market—and we're looking for someone who's ready to grow with us. If you're passionate about production planning and want to be involved in the entire value chain, from customer inquiry to final delivery, we'd love to hear from you. How you'll make an impact Analyze customer inquiries and calculate cost estimates Prepare and maintain detailed work instructions Create and manage production documentation Monitor material flow and ensure availability Maintain accurate master data in SAP S4HANA Collaborate closely with production, sales, procurement, engineering, and logistics Drive continuous improvement in planning and production processes Your background Technical expertise in a relevant field (e.g., polymechanic, industrial mechanic, mold maker, carpenter) Several years of experience in a similar role, ideally in planning or manufacturing Strong technical drawing and bill of materials interpretation skills Proficient in SAP and Microsoft Office tools Independent, detail-oriented, and a strong team player Fluent in German, with good command of English More about us Our flexible working models help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees are empowered and can thrive. Über die Position Werden Sie Teil unseres dynamischen Teams in Klingnau, das sich auf die hochpräzise Kunststoffverarbeitung auf Weltklasseniveau spezialisiert hat. Als wichtiger Akteur in Branchen wie Energie, Bahn, Luft- und Raumfahrt, industrielle Dienstleistungen und mehr, sind wir stolz darauf, massgeschneiderte, zuverlässige und innovative Lösungen für unsere globalen Kunden zu liefern. Unser Erfolg basiert auf einer kollaborativen Teamkultur, schlanken Entscheidungswegen und einem starken Fokus auf Automatisierung und Prozessoptimierung. Wir entwickeln uns ständig weiter, um den 
• Anforderungen eines schnelllebigen Marktes gerecht zu werden – und suchen jemanden, der mit uns wachsen möchte. Wenn Sie eine Leidenschaft für Produktionsplanung haben und in die gesamte Wertschöpfungskette – von der Kundenanfrage bis zur Auslieferung – eingebunden sein möchten, freuen wir uns auf Ihre Bewerbung. Das können Sie bewirken Analyse von Kundenanfragen und Erstellung von Kalkulationen Erstellung und Pflege detaillierter Arbeitsanweisungen Erstellung und Verwaltung von Produktionsunterlagen Überwachung des Materialflusses und Sicherstellung der Verfügbarkeit Pflege von Stammdaten in SAP S4HANA Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Produktion, Vertrieb, Einkauf, Engineering und Logistik Kontinuierliche Verbesserung der Planungs- und Produktionsprozesse Das bringen Sie mit Technische Ausbildung in einem relevanten Bereich (z. B. Polymechaniker, Industriemechaniker, Werkzeugmacher, Schreiner) Mehrjährige Erfahrung in einer ähnlichen Funktion, idealerweise in der Planung oder Fertigung Sehr gute Kenntnisse im Lesen technischer Zeichnungen und Stücklisten Sicherer Umgang mit SAP und Microsoft Office Selbstständige, detailorientierte Arbeitsweise und Teamfähigkeit Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse sowie gute Englischkenntnisse Mehr über uns Unsere flexiblen Arbeitsmodelle helfen Ihnen, die persönliche und geschäftliche Leistung zu optimieren und gleichzeitig ein Umfeld zu schaffen, in dem alle Mitarbeitenden befähigt sind und sich entfalten können.

jobs.title: Internship / Working Student in Business Project Management 40 - 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
The opportunity Hitachi Energy, High Voltage Products, is a global leader in power transmission and distribution. The Service Business Unit ensures worldwide after-sales support for GCB and GIS systems. You will join a collaborative team driving growth and operational excellence. You support a Business Project Manager across impactful internal initiatives. As an intern or a working student you gain insights across the full service value chain and take ownership of selected projects under guidance. The duration is 6 - 12 months. How you'll make an impact Support execution of internal projects across the service value chain Collaborate with stakeholders from different functions and regions Contribute to initiatives improving efficiency and collaboration Prepare and structure project documentation and presentations Track progress and ensure transparent communication across teams Identify improvement opportunities and support implementation Take ownership of smaller projects under supervision Support coordination and alignment within the project environment Your background E nrolled Student (Bachelor or Master) or Graduate in Industrial Engineering, Mechanical \/ Electrical Engineer, Business Management, or related field Strong interest in project management and collaboration Basic technical or IT understanding Analytical mindset and structured way of working Proactive communication style and problem solving attitude Strong MS Office skills and fluency in English and German More about us We are a technology-driven company with a strong focus on innovation, continuous improvement, and sustainable manufacturing. 
• We offer flexible working conditions, dedicated mentorship, and a supportive, inclusive environment where you can grow personally and professionally – empowering you to thrive while balancing life and work. We look forward to receiving your application, including a brief cover letter and a transcript of records, along with your CV. Non-EU\/EFTA citizens, please note that an official university certificate showing that an internship is a mandatory part of your studies is required.

jobs.title: Energy and Power System Modeler and Analyst (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The Opportunity The power sector is transforming rapidly. Renewable integration, distributed energy resources, electrification, sector coupling, and evolving market designs are reshaping how power systems are planned and operated. To address these challenges, Hitachi Energy established the Market Innovation function to complement technology‑driven innovation with a strong market perspective. Within our Power Systems of the Future research program, you help shape medium‑ and long‑term views on global power system transformation and translate them into innovative, practical solutions. In this role, you combine future‑oriented energy system modeling with deep technical power system analysis. You develop scenarios, improve planning tools, perform advanced grid studies, and build robust analytical workflows. You work at the intersection of strategy, engineering, and research bridging long‑term system planning with real‑world technical performance. How you'll make an impact Develop medium‑ and long‑term energy transition scenarios across regions Analyze impacts of electrification, hydrogen, storage, and market evolution Translate policy, technology, and market trends into modeling assumptions Improve capacity expansion and system planning models and tools Enhance optimization methods, algorithms, and computational workflows Perform advanced power system studies, including load flow and dynamics Assess integration of inverter‑based resources and grid‑forming controls Link long‑term planning insights with detailed technical grid studies Your Background MSc in Electrical Engineering, Energy Systems, Computer Science, or similar Strong experience in energy system modeling and scenario analysis Solid knowledge of mathematical optimization and advanced simulations Experience with steady‑state, dynamic, and fault studies in power systems Understanding of converter‑dominated grids and inverter‑based resources Hands‑on programming skills in Python and MATLAB\/Simulink Experience with power system tools such as PowerFactory, PSS®E, or PSCAD Experience with optimization solvers and modeling workflows like Gurobi or equivalent tools More About Us Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

jobs.title: Secondary Design Engineer 80 – 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The opportunity We are looking for a Secondary Design Engineer to join our GIS engineering team. In this role, you will support the execution of secondary engineering deliverables for high-voltage GIS projects, including Local Control Cabinet (LCC) and digital substation applications. You will contribute to engineering documentation across project phases and help deliver high-quality, standard-compliant results while building your expertise in secondary design engineering and tools such as Zuken E3. How you'll make an impact Prepare schematics and related engineering documents for GIS secondary engineering scopes, including LCC and digital substation applications Support engineering execution across project phases, from base design and detail design through manufacturing documentation and as-built updates Create preliminary BOMs, reports, and manufacturing documents using approved engineering tools and standard processes Perform structured self-checks and contribute to technically correct, high-quality, and standard-compliant deliverables Support technical clarifications with internal stakeholders, project teams, and factories, and help document and close open points Contribute to continuous improvement, standardization, and engineering best practices, including participation in relevant expert communities Apply internal guidelines, engineering standards, and quality requirements while supporting safe and efficient project execution Your background Degree in Electrical Engineering or a related engineering discipline 2–3 years of professional experience in secondary engineering, design engineering, or project engineering is expected Practical experience with engineering tools such as Zuken E3 or comparable ECAD \/ engineering tools is required Basic knowledge of GIS, secondary engineering principles, and applicable standards such as IEC, IEEE, or ANSI is beneficial Structured and reliable way of working, willingness to learn, and ability to collaborate across functions and disciplines Fluency in English is required; German and other languages are an advantage More about us Hitachi Energy is a global technology leader advancing a sustainable energy future for all. You will work in a collaborative and international environment where innovation, learning, and continuous improvement are part of everyday work.

descriptionByLocale.fr: L'opportunité Nous cherchons un ingénieur de conception secondaire pour rejoindre notre équipe d'ingénierie SIG. Dans ce rôle, vous soutiendrez l'exécution des livrables d'ingénierie secondaire pour les projets SIG à haute tension, y compris le Cabinet de contrôle local (CCL) et les applications de sous-station numérique. Vous contribuerez à la documentation d'ingénierie au cours des phases du projet et vous pourrez obtenir des résultats de haute qualité et conformes aux normes tout en renforçant votre expertise en ingénierie de conception secondaire et en outils tels que Zuken E3. jobs.title: Research Scientist - Gas Insulation for High Voltage (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The opportunity   Join Hitachi Energy and shape sustainable high-voltage technologies. You will join an international R&D team focused on gas insulation. The team develops eco-efficient solutions for high-voltage applications. You will work on advanced research and industrial implementation. You will contribute to cutting-edge projects in gas-insulated switchgear. You will collaborate across research centers and business units. The role offers exposure to both theory and practical testing. You will grow your expertise in high-voltage engineering and gas physics. You will strengthen your skills in simulations and experimental methods. You will work in a collaborative and diverse environment. This role offers strong development opportunities and technical ownership. You will contribute to future-ready, sustainable energy solutions.   How you'll make an impact Actively contribute to research projects in gas insulation applications Conduct investigations on dielectric strength, dielectric recovery, partial discharge Plan and execute high-voltage experimental studies Model, simulate, interpret gas discharge phenomena Develop innovative concepts for gas-insulated technologies Support design and optimization of HV switchgear Collaborate with global teams and external research institutes Document results, publish findings and present your work at international conferences   Your background   PhD in Electrical Engineering, Physics, or related field with application in high voltage engineering Strong knowledge of gas insulation and discharge physics Practical experience in HV testing Expertise in simulation tools such as MATLAB, Python, or COMSOL Ability to analyze complex datasets and interpret results using statistical methods, modern AI tools Solid English communication skills and structured working style Relevant experience in industrial R&D is very beneficial   More about us   Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

descriptionByLocale.it: Unisciti a Hitachi Energy e modella tecnologie sostenibili ad alta tensione. Ti unirai a un team internazionale di R&D focalizzato sull'isolamento del gas. Crescerai la tua esperienza nell'ingegneria ad alta tensione e nella fisica del gas. Potrai rafforzare le tue competenze in simulazioni e metodi sperimentali. Potrai lavorare in un ambiente collaborativo e diversificato. Questo ruolo offre forti opportunità di sviluppo e la proprietà tecnica. Contribuirai a soluzioni energetiche sostenibili e future. descriptionByLocale.fr: L'opportunité Rejoignez Hitachi Énergie et façonnez des technologies durables à haute tension. Vous rejoindrez une équipe internationale de R-D axée sur l'isolation au gaz. L'équipe développe des solutions éco-efficaces pour les applications à haute tension. Vous travaillerez sur la recherche avancée et la mise en œuvre industrielle. Vous contribuerez à des projets de pointe dans le domaine des commutateurs à gaz. Vous collaborerez entre les centres de recherche et les unités d'affaires. Le rôle offre une exposition à la fois à la théorie et aux tests pratiques. Vous développerez votre expertise en ingénierie à haute tension et en physique des gaz. Vous renforcerez vos compétences en simulations et méthodes expérimentales. Vous travaillerez dans un environnement collaboratif et diversifié. Ce rôle offre de fortes possibilités de développement et de maîtrise technique. Vous contribuerez à des solutions énergétiques durables et prêtes à l'avenir. Comment vous allez avoir un impact Contribuer activement aux projets de recherche dans les applications d'isolation au gaz Mener des recherches sur la résistance diélectrique, la récupération diélectrique, la décharge partielle Planifier et exécuter des études expérimentales à haute tension Modéliser, simuler, interpréter des phénomènes de décharge au gaz Développer des concepts innovants pour les technologies à isolation au gaz Soutenir la conception et l'optimisation du commutateur HV Collaborer avec des équipes mondiales et des instituts de recherche externes Documenter les résultats, publier les résultats et présenter vos travaux lors de conférences internationales Votre formation Doctorat en génie électrique, physique ou domaine connexe avec application en génie haute tension Forte connaissance de l'isolation des gaz et de la physique des décharges Expérience pratique en test HV Expertise en outils de simulation tels que MATLAB, Python ou COMSOL Capacité d'analyser des ensembles de données complexes et d'interpréter les résultats à l'aide de méthodes statistiques, d'outils modernes d'IA Compétences de communication en anglais solide et style de travail structuré L'expérience pertinente en R-D industrielle est très bénéfique.

jobs.title: System Engineer (SCADA/RTU) for Substation Automation 80 – 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The opportunity To strengthen our engineering team, we are looking for a System Engineer (SCADA\/RTU) to work on control and protection systems in the field of power grid substations. Openness, customer orientation, and innovation are key success factors in our working environment. You should be a team player who collaborates across different organizational levels in an intercultural environment. If you enjoy combining technical expertise with a strong customer focus, this is an opportunity for you! Early-career professionals are also welcome to apply. Welcome to our team! How you'll make an impact In this challenging position, you will design sub-station control systems (SCADA) for high- and medium-voltage switchgear in accordance with the latest technology standards such as IEC 61850, IEC 104, and other protocols You will integrate the systems, including the parameterization of the Ethernet-based communication structure Furthermore, you will implement project-specific functions and software applications, carry out tests, and coordinate interfaces Supporting on-site commissioning at facilities throughout Switzerland is also part of your role You will support the project manager in technical matters and coordinate both customers and in-ternal partners You will create operating manuals tailored to customer requirements Your background Bachelor's or master's degree in power engineering, electrical engineering, or an equivalent qualification Basic knowledge of control and protection systems, RTU systems, or process automation systems is an advantage You have basic knowledge of cybersecurity and network architecture Alongside strong communication skills and team spirit, you must demonstrate the ability to work independently and take responsibility Fluent German (spoken and written) is required. Good English skills are essential; additional languages such as French are an advantage More about us Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

jobs.title: Global SCM Material Sustainability Lead (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The opportunity Hitachi Energy is seeking a Global SCM Material Sustainability Lead for the Business Unit Transformers to join our innovative and forward-thinking team. In this role, you will lead the end-to-end management of the Material Sustainability pillar, aligning methodologies for environmental impact assessments, defining processes, implementing initiatives, and monitoring progress across the business unit. This is your opportunity to align with business objectives and regulatory requirements, supporting the organization's sustainability goals and making a meaningful impact in the energy industry. How you will make an impact Contribute to the development of the business unit's supply chain sustainability strategy, focusing on material sustainability and alignment with business objectives. Monitor emerging material sustainability trends, regulatory changes, and customer requirements, integrating them into strategic and operational plans. Develop standardized process flows for material sustainability requirements, ensuring seamless coordination and effective implementation. Identify opportunities to enhance material sustainability, driving projects such as decarbonization efforts and improving practices with key global suppliers. Implement performance monitoring systems to track progress against material sustainability goals, enabling data-driven decisions and continuous improvement. Develop and maintain a comprehensive database of primary sustainability data for materials, ensuring accurate information and promoting adoption across the supply chain. This includes defining the data needed to enable consistent LCA\/EPD\/PCF assessments and comparable material-level impact evaluations. Engage with suppliers and cross-functional teams to guide strategic suppliers toward emission-zero goals and sustainable practices. Develop and deliver training on material sustainability topics, fostering a culture of continuous improvement and best practices across the SCM community. Align the BU Transformers methodologies for assessing material environmental impacts in line with evolving LCA\/EPD standards. Apply these methodologies to transformer-relevant materials and decisions by defining measurable requirements for suppliers and by supporting internal stakeholders with actionable guidance for material choices, claims, and customer requests. Your background Degree in Environmental Science, Engineering, Supply Chain Management, or a related field. Minimum of 10 years of experience in supply chain management with focus on sustainability, with proven leadership in strategy and roadmap creation, preferably within global or large-scale organizations. Strong expertise in materials sustainability standards such as ISO 14040\/14044, ISO 14067, the Greenhouse Gas Protocol, and related frameworks. Extensive experience with Life Cycle Assessments (LCA), Environmental Product Declarations (EPDs), and implementing global sustainability programs related to materials and suppliers. Strong leadership skills with a track record of developing and executing strategic initiatives in complex, international environments. Excellent communication, presentation, and influencing skills, with the ability to build relationships and inspire change at all organization levels.

jobs.title: Equipment Engineer -Diffusion, 80 – 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The opportunity    Join Hitachi, Ltd. as an Equipment Engineer and play a key role in optimizing and maintaining manufacturing equipment to ensure high performance, reliability, and efficiency. You will work in a collaborative environment, contributing to continuous improvement and supporting innovative manufacturing processes.  As a Diffusion Maintenance Engineer, you will play a critical role in ensuring the availability, efficiency, and continuous improvement of semiconductor high temperature production systems. This role focuses on the Corrective and Preventive maintenance and optimization of Diffusion & Cleaning equipment while working closely with cross-functional teams to enhance safety, productivity, and system reliability. How you'll make an impact  Develop and implement modifications and upgrades to existing manufacturing equipment to improve efficiency, yield, and safety  Perform routine maintenance, troubleshooting, and repair of complex manufacturing machinery and systems  Analyse equipment performance data to identify trends, predict failures, and implement preventive measures  Collaborate with production, R&D, and quality teams to resolve equipment-related issues and optimize processes  Create and maintain documentation for equipment operation, maintenance procedures, and technical specifications  Train technicians and operators on new equipment and updated procedures  Manage spare parts inventory and ensure timely procurement of required components and ensure compliance with safety standards and environmental regulations  Support the selection, installation, and qualification of new manufacturing equipment  Your background  Bachelor's degree in mechanical engineering or electrical Engineering  Minimum 2 years of experience in equipment engineering within a manufacturing environment  Experience in the Semiconductor field is highly desirable Strong understanding of mechanical, electrical, and control systems  Solid understanding of electronics, mechanics, and pneumatics; experience with Diffusion Semiconductor systems is a plus (e.g., ASM, Centrotherm furnaces) Proven ability to troubleshoot complex machinery and identify root causes of failures  Familiarity with lean manufacturing principles and continuous improvement methods  Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills  Ability to work independently and as part of a team in a fast-paced environment  English is mandatory, German is beneficial   More about us   Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

jobs.title: Scientist in Physics and Scientific Programming (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The opportunity   We are looking for a research scientist with expertise in modelling and simulation of complex physical phenomena to join our Research Center in Baden\/Switzerland. In an interdisciplinary environment, you will drive cutting-edge innovation and develop new solutions to improve the performance and reliability of power grids devices, such as transformers, circuit breakers, power semiconductors. Seize this unique opportunity and join our motivated team to contribute to a sustainable energy future for all!  How you'll make an impact   You innovate: Drive the translation of innovative ideas into new power grid device features through physical modeling, scientific programming, and advanced data analysis You investigate: Elaborate and implement new models to improve the understanding of physical phenomena, such as electromagnetic, fluid-dynamics, mechanical and nonlinear material behavior You take initiative: Collaborate with a global and interdisciplinary team of researchers and engineers across research and business units to identify, shape, and solve impactful industrial challenges You collaborate: Build relationships within the company and actively share your knowledge and expertise. jobs.title: Internship in Computational Fluid Dynamics for Circuit Breakers 80 - 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
The opportunity Join an innovative R&D team shaping high voltage technologies. You will contribute to the simulation and analysis of thermo-fluid phenomena relevant to switching performance and thermal behavior in gas circuit breakers. The work combines numerical simulation, data analysis, and engineering evaluation, supporting ongoing product development activities. You will work in a multidisciplinary R&D environment and collaborate with experienced engineers and researchers in the field of high-voltage technology. Bring your curiosity and make an impact from day one. The duration of the internship is 6 - 12 months. How you'll make an impact Setup and run 2D and 3D CFD simulations Perform thermo-fluid simulations using ANSYS Fluent Analyze and evaluate simulation and experimental data Post-process results using internal engineering tools Collaborate on improving simulation models and approaches Support product development through engineering insights Document simulation setups and key findings Contribute ideas to enhance performance and design Your background Enrolled in Bachelor or Master or done with studies in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Physics, or similar field Knowledge of computational fluid dynamics and thermal management Familiarity with CAD tools and experience using ANSYS Fluent Programming skills in Python or MATLAB Strong English communication skills and team-oriented mindset Willingness to handle responsibilities independently More about us We are a technology-driven company with a strong focus on innovation, continuous improvement, and sustainable manufacturing. 
• We offer flexible working conditions, dedicated mentorship, and a supportive, inclusive environment where you can grow personally and professionally – empowering you to thrive while balancing life and work. We look forward to receiving your application, including a brief cover letter and a transcript of records, along with your CV. Non-EU\/EFTA citizens, please note that an official university certificate showing that an internship is a mandatory part of your studies is required.

jobs.title: Structural Mechanical Design Engineer 80 - 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The opportunity Join our Dry Transformer Engineering team and play a pivotal role in the development of advanced transformer technologies that elevate safety, efficiency, and sustainability across critical power networks. In this position, you will collaborate with cross‑functional partners — including R&D, Production, Quality, and Supply Chain — to translate complex customer requirements into reliable, manufacturable engineering solutions.  How you'll make an impact Conduct structural analysis by hand calculations and finite element simulations on electrical machines for a variety of load cases (e.g. lifting, seismic, short circuit, shock, fatigue etc.) Perform experimental test for the validation of finite element models through comparison with experimental results Conduct experimental testing campaign for the diagnostic of structure-borne and air-borne noise of electrical equipment Ensure that all structural designs complie with relevant industry codes, standards and regulations Prepare detailed structural reports to be delivered to our customers Assist the design engineers in the development of transformer and reactors structural components Support other departments in preparing for customer technical meetings and design reviews Your background Master's degree in mechanical engineering or similar field Proficiency with numerical and analytical calculation software such as ANSYS, nCode, Fluent, MATLAB Knowledge of relevant building codes (Eurocode) and regulations Experience with noise and vibration measurements and relevant data post-processing Work experience in the transformer industry as well as knowledge of transformer manufacturing process, assembly procedures and best practices is a plus Experience with CAD software such as CREO and Inventor is an advantage Ability to communicate effectively in English, both verbally and written Ability to work effectively both individually and in a team More about us Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

jobs.description: Über die Position Der Bereich High Voltage Products der Hitachi Energy ist weltweit anerkannt als Spezialist für Anlagen der Stromübertragung und -verteilung. Innerhalb des Bereichs High Voltage Products ist der Bereich Hochstromsysteme verantwortlich für Entwicklung, Verkauf, Produktion und den Service von Generatorleistungsschaltern. Act as GPG I&C Plato Admin, train crossfunctional teams, support the organization on the usage and ensure that foundation content is updated . jobs.title: Project Manager Product Implementation 80 – 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The opportunity In this role, you will take ownership of the successful implementation of new and transferred products, ensuring they are ready for market launch and customer installation. You will play a key role in aligning cross-functional teams, driving operational readiness, and ensuring high-quality execution across engineering, procurement, production, and delivery. This position offers a dynamic environment where you can shape processes, drive continuous improvement, and contribute directly to the success of innovative GIS products. How you'll make an impact Lead end-to-end product implementation projects from initiation to closure Define scope, objectives, and deliverables with key stakeholders Develop and manage project plans, timelines, resources, and budgets Align and coordinate cross-functional teams to ensure execution readiness Ensure completeness and accuracy of master data across all systems Monitor early production phases (test objects and zero series) to validate readiness Identify risks, drive mitigation actions, and ensure transparent communication Track production, assembly, and testing processes and drive continuous improvement Your background Bachelor's degree in engineering, business administration, or a related field Minimum 5 years of project management experience, ideally in product implementation Proven experience delivering complex technical or industrial projects Strong knowledge of project management methodologies (e.g., Agile, Waterfall) Experience working in cross-functional and international environments Solid understanding of industrial product lifecycles; GIS experience is a plus Strong communication and stakeholder management skills PMP certification and knowledge of tools like MS Project or Jira are advantageous More about us   Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

descriptionByLocale.it: L'opportunità In questo ruolo, assumerai la responsabilità dell'implementazione di successo di prodotti nuovi e trasferiti, assicurandoti che siano pronti per il lancio sul mercato e l'installazione da parte del cliente. Svolgerai un ruolo chiave nell'allineamento dei team interfunzionali, nella promozione della prontezza operativa e nel garantire un'esecuzione di alta qualità nei settori di ingegneria, approvvigionamento, produzione e consegna. Questa posizione offre un ambiente dinamico in cui è possibile modellare i processi, promuovere il miglioramento continuo e contribuire direttamente al successo di prodotti GIS innovativi. Come avrai un impatto Guidare progetti di implementazione del prodotto end-to-end dall'inizio alla chiusura Definire ambito, obiettivi e risultati finali con le principali parti interessate Sviluppare e gestire piani di progetto, tempistiche, risorse e budget Allineare e coordinare team interfunzionali per garantire la preparazione all'esecuzione Garantire la completezza e l'accuratezza dei dati master in tutti i sistemi Monitorare le prime fasi di produzione (oggetti di test e serie zero) per convalidare la preparazione Identificare i rischi, promuovere azioni di mitigazione e garantire una comunicazione trasparente Monitorare i processi di produzione, assemblaggio e test e promuovere il miglioramento continuo background Laurea in ingegneria, amministrazione aziendale o un campo correlato Minimo 5 anni di esperienza nella gestione di progetti, idealmente nell'implementazione del prodotto Comprovata esperienza nella realizzazione di progetti tecnici o industriali complessi Forte conoscenza delle metodologie di gestione dei progetti (ad es. Agile, Waterfall) Esperienza di lavoro in ambienti interfunzionali e internazionali Solida comprensione dei cicli di vita dei prodotti industriali; L'esperienza GIS è un vantaggio Forti capacità di comunicazione e gestione delle parti interessate La certificazione PMP e la conoscenza di strumenti come MS Project o Jira sono vantaggiose Maggiori informazioni su di noi Le nostre pratiche di lavoro flessibili ti aiutano a ottimizzare le prestazioni personali e aziendali creando al contempo un ambiente in cui tutti i dipendenti possono sviluppare le proprie competenze e crescere.

descriptionByLocale.de: Die Chance: In dieser Rolle übernehmen Sie die Verantwortung für die erfolgreiche Implementierung neuer und übertragener Produkte und stellen sicher, dass diese für die Markteinführung und Installation beim Kunden bereit sind. Sie spielen eine Schlüsselrolle bei der Ausrichtung funktionsübergreifender Teams, der Förderung der Betriebsbereitschaft und der Sicherstellung einer qualitativ hochwertigen Ausführung in den Bereichen Technik, Beschaffung, Produktion und Lieferung. Diese Position bietet ein dynamisches Umfeld, in dem Sie Prozesse gestalten, kontinuierliche Verbesserungen vorantreiben und direkt zum Erfolg innovativer GIS-Produkte beitragen können. Wie Sie etwas bewirken werden Leiten Sie End-to-End-Produktimplementierungsprojekte von der Initiierung bis zum Abschluss. Definieren Sie Umfang, Ziele und Ergebnisse mit den wichtigsten Stakeholdern. Entwickeln und verwalten Sie Projektpläne, Zeitpläne, Ressourcen und Budgets. Richten Sie funktionsübergreifende Teams aus und koordinieren Sie sie, um die Ausführungsbereitschaft sicherzustellen. Stellen Sie die Vollständigkeit und Genauigkeit der Stammdaten in allen Systemen sicher. Überwachen Sie frühe Produktionsphasen (Testobjekte und Nullserien), um die Bereitschaft zu validieren. Identifizieren Sie Risiken, treiben Sie Abhilfemaßnahmen voran und stellen Sie eine transparente Kommunikation sicher. Verfolgen Sie Produktions-, Montage- und Testprozesse und treiben Sie kontinuierliche Verbesserungen voran Hintergrund Bachelor-Abschluss in Ingenieurwissenschaften, Betriebswirtschaft oder einem verwandten Bereich Mindestens 5 Jahre Erfahrung im Projektmanagement, idealerweise in der Produktimplementierung Nachgewiesene Erfahrung in der Durchführung komplexer technischer oder industrieller Projekte Umfangreiche Kenntnisse der Projektmanagementmethoden (z. B. Agile, Wasserfall) Erfahrung in der Arbeit in funktionsübergreifenden und internationalen Umgebungen Solides Verständnis der Lebenszyklen industrieller Produkte; GIS-Erfahrung ist von Vorteil. Starke Kommunikations- und Stakeholder-Managementfähigkeiten. PMP-Zertifizierung und Kenntnisse von Tools wie MS Project oder Jira sind von Vorteil. Mehr über uns. Unsere flexiblen Arbeitspraktiken helfen Ihnen, die persönliche und geschäftliche Leistung zu optimieren und gleichzeitig ein Umfeld zu schaffen, in dem alle Mitarbeiter ihre Fähigkeiten entwickeln und wachsen können.
descriptionByLocale.fr: L'opportunité Dans ce rôle, vous prendrez en charge la mise en œuvre réussie des produits nouveaux et transférés, en vous assurant qu'ils sont prêts pour le lancement sur le marché et l'installation chez le client. Vous jouerez un rôle clé dans l’alignement des équipes interfonctionnelles, dans la préparation opérationnelle et dans la garantie d’une exécution de haute qualité en matière d’ingénierie, d’approvisionnement, de production et de livraison. Ce poste offre un environnement dynamique dans lequel vous pouvez façonner les processus, conduire une amélioration continue et contribuer directement au succès des produits SIG innovants. jobs.title: Research Team Manager - Circuit Breaker (f/m/d)
jobs.description: We are looking for a passionate Research Team Manager to lead our multidisciplinary Circuit Breaker research team in Baden-Dättwil (Switzerland), part of the Central European Hitachi Energy Research Center. How you'll make an impact   You are a leader Set clear goals and priorities for the team, ensuring alignment with the overall research strategy Encourage a culture of continuous learning and innovation, supporting the team in staying at the forefront of technological advancements Build capabilities and succession within the team: plan capacity, people and resources; coach, mentor and develop engineers; maintain the team as a center of excellence for interrupter technology   You contribute Oversee different research laboratories, ensuring high safety standards and compliance Contribute to research projects and pre-studies with your own scientific expertise Participate in test campaigns, including taking on the electrical emergency first aider role (training will be provided)   You are impactful Foster the creation of new research project proposals and strategic research initiatives Contribute to an innovative, motivating, and inclusive working environment   You foster collaboration Maintain and expand a strong network with relevant business units and leading universities Promote collaboration across all Hitachi Energy Research Centers   Your background   PhD in Physics, Electrical Engineering, or a related field Technical expertise in areas such as circuit breakers, high power testing, plasma physics, along with an interest in emerging research and technology fields Several years of experience and a proven track record in industrial R&D, including people leadership experience Fluency in English (written and spoken); German is an advantage   If you are eager to drive innovation in a dynamic research environment, we look forward to your application!

jobs.title: R&D Designer 60% -100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The opportunity For our Business Unit High Voltage Products in Zurich‑Oerlikon, we are looking for an R&D Designer to strengthen our Interrupter Development team within High Voltage Circuit Breaker development. In this role, you will contribute to product design and development activities within our CAD\/PLM landscape for ongoing R&D projects. The position is part of the Interrupter Development team and works closely with the responsible R&D engineers within product development projects. You will be responsible for the creation, maintenance, and quality of 3D\/2D model data for assigned components and assemblies, supporting virtual product development from prototype phase to serial production. Are you looking for technical challenges in a fast‑paced development environment? Do you quickly grasp technical topics and enjoy working through different viewpoints to reach robust technical solutions? Do you like solving complex design tasks in close collaboration with experienced engineers? Then this position offers the right opportunity for you. Join our team and contribute to the development of high‑quality high‑voltage products in an international working environment in Zurich. How you'll make an impact   Take responsibility for the 3D\/2D CAD\/PLM implementation from concept design to series production within product development projects on high voltage switching devices Create, modify and analyze the design of selected components and assemblies of switching devices in close collaboration with R&D Engineers, and collaborate and support other project stakeholders, such as supply chain and product care Contribute to the continuous improvement of our CAD\/PLM\/SAP related processes and activities and drive the overall model quality Your background   Successfully completed apprenticeship as Konstrukteur\/in EFZ Excellent know-how in CAD\/PLM systems, ideally PTC CREO and PTC Windchill Good Knowledge in SAP\/Office High expectations on quality of work in all regards Independent, proactive and goal-oriented personality Practically oriented and hands-on way of working Team-player, committed, willing to learn Good command of German both written and spoken

descriptionByLocale.it: L'opportunità Per la nostra business unit Prodotti ad alta tensione a Zurigo‑Oerlikon, stiamo cercando un progettista di ricerca e sviluppo per rafforzare il nostro team di sviluppo interruttori nell'ambito dello sviluppo di interruttori automatici ad alta tensione. In questo ruolo, contribuirai alle attività di progettazione e sviluppo del prodotto all'interno del nostro panorama CAD\/PLM per progetti di ricerca e sviluppo in corso. La posizione fa parte del team di sviluppo degli interruttori e lavora a stretto contatto con gli ingegneri responsabili di ricerca e sviluppo nell'ambito dei progetti di sviluppo prodotto. Sarai responsabile della creazione, della manutenzione e della qualità dei dati del modello 3D\/2D per i componenti e gli assiemi assegnati, supportando lo sviluppo del prodotto virtuale dalla fase di prototipo alla produzione in serie. Cerchi sfide tecniche in un ambiente di sviluppo frenetico? Afferra rapidamente argomenti tecnici e ti piace lavorare attraverso diversi punti di vista per raggiungere solide soluzioni tecniche? Ti piace risolvere compiti di progettazione complessi in stretta collaborazione con ingegneri esperti? Allora questa posizione offre l'opportunità giusta per te. Unisciti al nostro team e contribuisci allo sviluppo di prodotti ad alta tensione di alta qualità in un ambiente di lavoro internazionale a Zurigo. Come avrai un impatto Assumerti la responsabilità dell'implementazione 3D\/2D CAD\/PLM, dal concept design alla produzione in serie, nell'ambito di progetti di sviluppo prodotto su dispositivi di commutazione ad alta tensione Creare, modificare e analizzare la progettazione di componenti e assiemi selezionati di dispositivi di commutazione in stretta collaborazione con ingegneri di ricerca e sviluppo e collaborare e supportare altre parti interessate del progetto, come la catena di fornitura e la cura del prodotto Contribuire al miglioramento continuo dei nostri processi e attività relativi a CAD\/PLM\/SAP e promuovere la qualità complessiva del modello Il tuo background Completato con successo apprendistato come Konstrukteur\/in EFZ Eccellente know-how nei sistemi CAD\/PLM, idealmente PTC CREO e PTC Windchill Buona conoscenza di SAP\/Office Elevate aspettative sulla qualità del lavoro sotto tutti gli aspetti Personalità indipendente, proattiva e orientata agli obiettivi Modo di lavorare pratico e orientato alla pratica Giocatore di squadra, impegnato, disposto ad apprendere Buona padronanza del tedesco sia scritto che parlato

descriptionByLocale.de: Die Chance Für unseren Geschäftsbereich Hochspannungsprodukte in Zürich-Oerlikon suchen wir einen F&E-Designer zur Verstärkung unseres Interrupter-Entwicklungsteams im Bereich der Entwicklung von Hochspannungs-Leistungsschaltern. In dieser Rolle tragen Sie zu Produktdesign- und Entwicklungsaktivitäten innerhalb unserer CAD/PLM-Landschaft für laufende F&E-Projekte bei. Die Position ist Teil des Interrupter-Entwicklungsteams und arbeitet im Rahmen von Produktentwicklungsprojekten eng mit den verantwortlichen F&E-Ingenieuren zusammen. Sie sind für die Erstellung, Pflege und Qualität von 3D-/2D-Modelldaten für zugewiesene Komponenten und Baugruppen verantwortlich und unterstützen die virtuelle Produktentwicklung von der Prototypenphase bis zur Serienproduktion. Suchen Sie technische Herausforderungen in einer schnelllebigen Entwicklungsumgebung? Sie haben ein schnelles Verständnis für technische Themen und haben Spaß daran, durch unterschiedliche Sichtweisen zu robusten technischen Lösungen zu gelangen? Lösen Sie gerne komplexe Konstruktionsaufgaben in enger Zusammenarbeit mit erfahrenen Ingenieuren? Dann bietet diese Position genau das Richtige für Sie. Werden Sie Teil unseres Teams und tragen Sie in einem internationalen Arbeitsumfeld in Zürich zur Entwicklung hochwertiger Hochspannungsprodukte bei. Wie Sie etwas bewirken werden Übernehmen Sie die Verantwortung für die 3D-/2D-CAD-/PLM-Implementierung vom Konzeptdesign bis zur Serienproduktion im Rahmen von Produktentwicklungsprojekten für Hochspannungsschaltgeräte. Erstellen, modifizieren und analysieren Sie das Design ausgewählter Komponenten und Baugruppen von Schaltgeräten in enger Zusammenarbeit mit F&E-Ingenieuren und arbeiten Sie mit anderen Projektbeteiligten zusammen und unterstützen Sie sie, z. B. Lieferkette und Produktpflege. Tragen Sie zur kontinuierlichen Verbesserung unserer CAD-/PLM-/SAP-bezogenen Prozesse und Aktivitäten bei und fördern Sie die Gesamtmodellqualität. Ihr Hintergrund. Erfolgreich abgeschlossene Ausbildung als Konstrukteur\/in EFZ Hervorragende Kenntnisse in CAD\/PLM-Systemen, idealerweise PTC CREO und PTC Windchill Gute Kenntnisse in SAP\/Office Hoher Anspruch an die Arbeitsqualität in allen Belangen Selbstständige, proaktive und zielorientierte Persönlichkeit Praxisorientierte und praxisorientierte Arbeitsweise Teamplayer, engagiert, lernwillig Gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift
descriptionByLocale.fr: L'opportunité Pour notre division Produits haute tension à Zurich‑Oerlikon, nous recherchons un concepteur R&D pour renforcer notre équipe de développement d'interrupteurs dans le développement de disjoncteurs haute tension. Dans ce rôle, vous contribuerez aux activités de conception et de développement de produits au sein de notre paysage CAO\/PLM pour les projets de R&D en cours. Le poste fait partie de l'équipe de développement d'interrupteurs et travaille en étroite collaboration avec les ingénieurs R&D responsables des projets de développement de produits. Vous serez responsable de la création, de la maintenance et de la qualité des données de modèles 3D\/2D pour les composants et assemblages assignés, prenant en charge le développement de produits virtuels depuis la phase de prototype jusqu'à la production en série. Êtes-vous à la recherche de défis techniques dans un environnement de développement au rythme rapide ? Vous maîtrisez rapidement les sujets techniques et aimez travailler à travers différents points de vue pour parvenir à des solutions techniques robustes ? Aimez-vous résoudre des tâches de conception complexes en étroite collaboration avec des ingénieurs expérimentés ? Alors ce poste offre la bonne opportunité pour vous. Rejoignez notre équipe et contribuez au développement de produits haute tension de haute qualité dans un environnement de travail international à Zurich. Comment vous aurez un impact Assumer la responsabilité de la mise en œuvre de la CAO\/PLM 3D\/2D, de la conception à la production en série dans le cadre de projets de développement de produits sur des appareils de commutation haute tension. Créer, modifier et analyser la conception de composants et d'assemblages sélectionnés d'appareils de commutation en étroite collaboration avec les ingénieurs R&D, et collaborer et soutenir les autres parties prenantes du projet, telles que la chaîne d'approvisionnement et l'entretien des produits. Contribuer à l'amélioration continue de nos processus et activités liés à la CAO\/PLM\/SAP et piloter la qualité globale du modèle. Konstrukteur\/in EFZ Excellent savoir-faire en systèmes CAO\/PLM, idéalement PTC CREO et PTC Windchill Bonnes connaissances en SAP\/Office Attentes élevées en matière de qualité de travail à tous égards Personnalité indépendante, proactive et orientée vers les objectifs Orientation pratique et méthode de travail pratique Esprit d'équipe, engagé, désireux d'apprendre Bonne maîtrise de l'allemand à l'écrit et à l'oral

jobs.title: HSE Manager 80 – 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The opportunity Are you passionate about creating a safe and sustainable working environment where people can thrive? As our HSE Manager for PSC Switzerland, you will take full ownership of the Health, Safety, and Environment function and play a key role in shaping a strong safety culture across our organization. In this position, you will lead and develop the HSE team while acting as the Site Lead Manager (HSE) for our Training Center in Rüti and Service Logistic Center in Dietlikon. You will collaborate closely with leadership, employees, and external partners to ensure the highest health and safety standards, drive continuous improvement, and make a tangible impact on how we protect our people and operations every day. How you'll make an impact Lead HSE function and team for PSC Switzerland and serve as Site Lead Manager (HSE) for Training Center in Rüti and Service Logistic Center in Dietlikon  Ensure strong commitment to health and safety standards, guidelines, management systems, and procedures  Communicate health and safety initiatives, processes, and procedures to ensure uniform understanding across complex safety issues  Knowledge about OSHA legislation for construction sites and working experience in Safety-related positions  International experience and intercultural sensitivity and Solutions-oriented personality with strong engagement  Proficiency in English (written and oral), German of advantage and any other language is a plus  Approximately 25% Travel required More about us   Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

descriptionByLocale.de: Die Chance: Sind Sie leidenschaftlich daran interessiert, ein sicheres und nachhaltiges Arbeitsumfeld zu schaffen, in dem sich Menschen entfalten können? Als unser HSE-Manager für PSC Schweiz übernehmen Sie die volle Verantwortung für die Funktion Gesundheit, Sicherheit und Umwelt und spielen eine Schlüsselrolle bei der Gestaltung einer starken Sicherheitskultur in unserer gesamten Organisation. In dieser Position leiten und entwickeln Sie das HSE-Team und fungieren gleichzeitig als Site Lead Manager (HSE) für unser Schulungszentrum in Rüti und das Service Logistic Center in Dietlikon. Sie arbeiten eng mit Führungskräften, Mitarbeitern und externen Partnern zusammen, um höchste Gesundheits- und Sicherheitsstandards zu gewährleisten, kontinuierliche Verbesserungen voranzutreiben und spürbare Auswirkungen darauf zu haben, wie wir unsere Mitarbeiter und Betriebe jeden Tag schützen. So können Sie etwas bewirken: Leiten Sie die HSE-Funktion und das HSE-Team für PSC Schweiz und fungieren Sie als Site Lead Manager (HSE) für das Schulungszentrum in Rüti und das Service-Logistikzentrum in Dietlikon. Sorgen Sie für ein starkes Engagement für Gesundheits- und Sicherheitsstandards, Richtlinien, Managementsysteme und Verfahren. Kommunizieren Sie Gesundheits- und Sicherheitsinitiativen, -prozesse und -verfahren, um ein einheitliches Verständnis in der gesamten Organisation zu gewährleisten. Überwachen Sie die Einhaltung von Gesundheits- und Sicherheitsanforderungen und behandeln Sie Nichtkonformitäten gemäß festgelegten Verfahren. Unterstützen und leiten Sie Management, Vorgesetzte und Mitarbeiter bei der Unfallverhütung und fungieren Sie als Schnittstelle bei Bedarf mit Auftragnehmern und Kunden zusammenarbeiten. Implementieren und pflegen Sie das Gesundheits- und Sicherheitsmanagementsystem und stellen Sie bei Bedarf Qualitätseingaben sicher. Führen Sie Sicherheitsaudits durch, untersuchen Sie Unfälle, identifizieren Sie Grundursachen und überwachen Sie Korrekturmaßnahmen. Bieten Sie Anleitung zu kompetenzbasierten Gesundheits- und Sicherheitsschulungen und leiten Sie HSE- und Nachhaltigkeitsprüfungen für Rüti und Dietlikon, um sicherzustellen, dass die Sicherungsaktivitäten abgeschlossen werden. Ihr Hintergrund. Mehr als 5 Jahre Erfahrung in Führungspositionen in einem Industrieunternehmen, vorzugsweise im HSE-, Bau- oder Fabrikumfeld. Starke Führungspersönlichkeit und ausgezeichnete zwischenmenschliche und kommunikative Fähigkeiten. Verständnis für Gesundheit und Sicherheit an Projekt-/Kundenstandorten und die Rolle, die ein Sicherheitssystem bei der Verwaltung des Gesamtrisikoprofils eines Standorts spielt. Praktische „praktische“ Erfahrung in der Entwicklung und Verwaltung von Sicherheitssystemen mit der Fähigkeit, sich mit standortspezifischen Details zu befassen und Lösungen für komplexe Sicherheitsprobleme zu entwickeln. Kenntnisse über die OSHA-Gesetzgebung für Baustellen und Berufserfahrung in sicherheitsbezogenen Positionen. Internationale Erfahrung und interkulturelle Sensibilität sowie lösungsorientierte Persönlichkeit mit starkem Engagement. Kenntnisse in Englisch (schriftlich und mündlich), Deutsch von Vorteil und jeder anderen Sprache sind von Vorteil. Ungefähr 25 % Reiseaufwand. Mehr darüber Uns Unsere flexiblen Arbeitspraktiken helfen Ihnen, die persönliche und geschäftliche Leistung zu optimieren und gleichzeitig ein Umfeld zu schaffen, in dem alle Mitarbeiter ihre Fähigkeiten entwickeln und wachsen können.
descriptionByLocale.fr: L'opportunité Êtes-vous passionné par la création d'un environnement de travail sûr et durable où les gens peuvent s'épanouir ? En tant que responsable HSE pour PSC Suisse, vous assumerez l'entière responsabilité de la fonction Santé, Sécurité et Environnement et jouerez un rôle clé dans la formation d'une culture de sécurité solide au sein de notre organisation. Dans ce poste, vous dirigerez et développerez l'équipe HSE tout en agissant en tant que Site Lead Manager (HSE) pour notre centre de formation à Rüti et notre centre logistique de services à Dietlikon. Vous collaborerez en étroite collaboration avec la direction, les employés et les partenaires externes pour garantir les normes de santé et de sécurité les plus élevées, favoriser l'amélioration continue et avoir un impact tangible sur la façon dont nous protégeons nos employés et nos opérations au quotidien. Comment vous aurez un impact Diriger la fonction et l'équipe HSE pour PSC Suisse et servir de Site Lead Manager (HSE) pour le centre de formation de Rüti et le centre logistique de service à Dietlikon Assurer un engagement fort envers les normes, directives, systèmes de gestion et procédures en matière de santé et de sécurité Communiquer les initiatives, les processus et les procédures en matière de santé et de sécurité pour garantir une compréhension uniforme dans toute l'organisation Surveiller le respect des exigences en matière de santé et de sécurité et gérer les non-conformités conformément aux procédures établies Aider et guider la direction, les superviseurs et les employés dans la prévention des accidents et agir en tant qu'interface avec les sous-traitants et les clients si nécessaire Mettre en œuvre et maintenir le système de gestion de la santé et de la sécurité et garantir la qualité si nécessaire Mener des audits de sécurité, enquêter sur les accidents, identifier les causes profondes et superviser les actions correctives Fournir des conseils sur la formation en matière de santé et de sécurité basée sur les compétences et diriger les examens HSE et de développement durable pour Rüti et Dietlikon, en garantissant que les activités d'assurance sont terminées. Votre expérience Plus de 5 ans d'expérience dans un rôle de direction dans une entreprise industrielle, de préférence dans un environnement HSE, de construction ou d'usine. et le rôle qu'un système de sécurité joue dans la gestion du profil de risque global d'un site Expérience pratique « pratique » dans le développement et la gestion de systèmes de sécurité avec la capacité d'approfondir les détails spécifiques au site et de développer des solutions à des problèmes de sécurité complexes. Connaissance de la législation OSHA pour les chantiers de construction et expérience professionnelle dans des postes liés à la sécurité Expérience internationale et sensibilité interculturelle et personnalité orientée solutions avec un fort engagement. La maîtrise de l'anglais (écrit et oral), de l'allemand (avantage) et de toute autre langue est un plus. performance personnelle et professionnelle tout en créant un environnement où tous les employés peuvent développer leurs compétences et s'épanouir.

jobs.description:
The opportunity Join our collaborative OSS team and support daily IT operations close to the business. You ensure employees have reliable devices and a smooth digital workplace experience. descriptionByLocale.it: Descrizione L'occasione Hitachi Energy, prodotti ad alta tensione, è rinomata in tutto il mondo come specialista per la trasmissione e la distribuzione di energia. La nostra unità Gas isolato Switchgears (GIS), con sede a Zürich-Oerlikon, è attiva nello sviluppo e nella produzione di sistemi di commutazione isolata a gas. Garantiamo l'elevata affidabilità dei nostri sistemi utilizzando strumenti e metodi di sviluppo all'avanguardia. Come Area Sales Manager, prenderete la proprietà di guidare la crescita aziendale all'interno della vostra regione assegnata e plasmare attivamente il nostro successo di mercato. Potrai lavorare a stretto contatto con clienti e partner, posizionando il nostro portafoglio all'avanguardia e fornendo soluzioni che soddisfano requisiti tecnici e commerciali complessi. jobs.description: The opportunity Hitachi Energy, High Voltage Products, is renowned worldwide as a specialist for power transmission and distribution. The Service unit is responsible for the worldwide after sales support of generator circuit-breaker (GCB) systems and gas insulated switchgears (GIS), including training, installation and commissioning, scheduled maintenance, added value services, troubleshooting, extensions, retrofits and replacements. As a Technical Buyer, you act as a key interface between Procurement, Engineering, Quality, and our global supplier network. You ensure that technically specified materials, components, and services are clearly defined, technically clarified, qualified, and available in line with project, quality, and delivery requirements. Through close cross‑functional collaboration, you translate engineering requirements into robust sourcing solutions and support supplier qualification and technical alignment. Your role contributes directly to product quality, supply reliability, and operational excellence, enabling Hitachi Energy to deliver innovative and sustainable energy solutions to our customers worldwide. How you'll make an impact Perform technical clarification of materials, drawings, specifications, and engineering changes in close collaboration with Engineering and suppliers Support and coordinate Production Part Approval Process (PPAP) activities, first samples, and supplier qualification processes Conduct technical evaluations of alternative materials, deviation requests, and obsolescence cases Collaborate closely with Strategic and Operational Buyers on supplier- and material-related topics Support the handling of supplier complaints, Non‑Conformity Reports (NCRs), and root cause analyses Support and participate in supplier assessments and technical supplier evaluations, including capability, quality, and process maturity reviews Contribute to supplier performance evaluations together with Quality and Strategic Procurement Ensure accuracy and completeness of material and supplier master data in SAP and act as the technical contact point during supplier escalations Support Service Organization and Project Teams in complex or urgent procurement topics Your background Completed technical education (e.g. Polymechanic, Automation Technician, Mechanical Technician, Design Engineer or similar) 3-5 years experience in technical procurement or SCM‑related roles Strong understanding of technical drawings, Bill of Material and manufacturing processes Experience working with suppliers on technical and quality‑related topics Structured, solution‑oriented, and communicative working style Good German skills and very good English skills SAP knowledge Proactive, structured, and solution-focused working style. Team oriented mindset with strong cross-functional collaboration More about us   Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Hitachi Energy, Prodotti ad alta tensione La nostra azienda è nota a livello mondiale come specialista per la trasmissione e la distribuzione di energia. L'unità di Servizio è responsabile del supporto post-vendita a livello mondiale per i sistemi di circuito-breaker per generatori (GCB) e per le sostanze di commutazione isolate con gas (GIS), compresi la formazione, l'installazione e la commissione, la manutenzione programmata, i servizi di valore aggiunto, la risoluzione dei problemi, gli estensioni, i retrofit e le sostituzioni. Descrizione del ruolo Come Acquirente Tecnico, agirai come interfaccia chiave tra Procurement, Ingegneria, Qualità e la nostra rete globale di fornitori. Assicurerai che i materiali, i componenti e i servizi specificiti tecnologicimente chiaramente definiti, chiariti, qualificati e disponibili in linea con le esigenze dei progetti, della qualità e della consegna. Attraverso una stretta collaborazione interfunzionale, traduirai le esigenze di ingegneria in soluzioni di approvvigionamento robuste e supporterai la qualifica dei fornitori e l'allineamento tecnico. Il tuo ruolo diretto alla qualità dei prodotti, alla affidabilità delle forniture e all'eccellenza operativa, volendo a Hitachi Energy di fornire soluzioni innovative e sostenibili per l'energia ai nostri clienti in tutto il mondo. Come realizzare un impatto - Esegui la chiarificazione tecnica dei materiali, dei disegni, delle specifiche e delle modifiche ingegneristiche in stretta collaborazione con l'Ingegneria e i fornitori. - Supporta e coordina le attività del Processo di Approvazione dei Parti di Produzione (PPAP), le prime prove e i processi di classificazione dei fornitori. - Conduci le necessarie tecniche di materiali alternativi, richieste di deviazione e boss di obsolescenza. - Collabora diretta con gli Acquirenti Strategici e Operativi sui temi relativi ai fornitori e ai materiali. - Supporta l'organizzazione e la gestione delle lamentele dei fornitori, dei Rapporti di Non Conformità (NCR) e delle analisi di causa radice. - Supporta e partecipa alle competenze dei fornitori e alle dirette tecniche dei fornitori, comprese le recensioni della capacità, della qualità e della maturità dei processi. - Contribuisce alle prestazioni dei fornitori insieme con la Qualità e la Procurement Strategica. - Assicura l'accuratezza e la completezza dei dati di master dei materiali e dei fornitori nel SAP e agiscono come punto di contatto tecnico durante le escalazioni dei fornitori. - Supporta l'Organizzazione di Servizio e le Squadre di Progetto in materia di approvvigionamento complessivo o urgenti.
• Requisiti - Educazione tecnica completata (ad esempio Polimematico, Tecnico di Automazione, Tecnico Meccanico, Ingegnere di Progetto o simili) - 3-5 anni di esperienza in approvvigionamento tecnico o ruoli correlati allo SCM - Buona comprensione dei disegni tecnici, della Lista di Materiali e dei processi di produzione - Esperienza nel lavoro con i fornitori su temi tecnici e di qualità - Stile di lavoro strutturato, orientaleto alla soluzione e comunicativo - Buone abilità in tedesco e ottimi livelli di inglese - Conoscenza di SAP - Stile di lavoro proattivo, strutturato e orientale alla soluzione - Mindset orientaleto al team con forte collaborazione interfunzionale Cosa? - Pratiche di lavoro flessibili che ti aiuti a ottimizzare il rendimento personale e professionale e a creare un ambiente in cui tutti gli impiegati possano sviluppare le loro competenze e crescere.

In questo ruolo, influenzerai direttamente la stabilità della rete elettrica svizzera e avrai l'opportunità unica di lavorare insieme a aziende leader nel settore energetico svizzero. Contribuire attivamente al miglioramento continuo all'interno dell'organizzazione del servizio. Completa tutti i report, la documentazione e i record di qualità esattamente nel sistema di tracciamento interno. Il vostro fondo certificato federale di competenza (CFC) in meccanica, manutenzione industriale, elettromeccanica, o un campo correlato (ad esempio, fabbro, meccanico, polimeccanico, tecnico di automazione). Almeno 2 anni di esperienza sul campo rilevante è considerato un bene. Volontà di viaggiare attraverso la Svizzera per lunghi periodi (minimo 1 settimana) e occasionalmente lavorare in 2×8 turni. Forte senso di responsabilità e alta consapevolezza dei requisiti di sicurezza. Licenza valida del conducente della categoria B. Buon comando del tedesco, con inglese e francese come lingue di lavoro aggiuntive. The opportunity At Hitachi Energy, we are committed to advancing a sustainable energy future for all by empowering the brightest minds to push technological boundaries. Join a diverse global community that thrives on collaboration, innovation, and purpose. We are looking for an experienced R&D Team Lead with a strong background in power semiconductor technologies and a proven track record in leading and developing high-performing R&D teams. How you'll make an impact Lead, manage, and develop a team of R&D engineers, fostering a high-performance, collaborative, and accountable team culture Take full responsibility for team delivery, including resource planning, performance management, and team development Own the end-to-end development of bipolar semiconductor devices, from concept to manufacturing transfer Define and execute R&D strategies aligned with business goals and technology roadmaps Drive innovation in materials, device architectures, and fabrication processes Collaborate closely with process engineering, product management, and manufacturing to ensure successful industrialization Actively monitor emerging technologies and market trends in power semiconductors Guide and review technical work, ensuring high quality standards and technical excellence Oversee project execution, including timelines, budget, and risk management Prepare and review technical documentation, presentations, and patent applications Your background PhD or master's degree in physics, Electrical Engineering, Materials Science, or a related discipline with strong grounding in semiconductor device physics Several years of experience in semiconductor R&D, including proven experience in leading and managing R&D teams Solid track record in people management, including performance management, coaching, and team development Extensive hands-on experience in power semiconductor devices (e.g. IGBTs, power MOSFETs, diodes, thyristors) or related applications Demonstrated ability to drive technical delivery through others in a complex R&D environment Strong interpersonal, leadership, and stakeholder management skills Experience in managing cross-functional teams and influencing without authority Strong ownership mindset with the ability to balance technical depth and leadership responsibilities Passion for developing people, driving innovation, and building high-performing teams More about us Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

jobs.title: Process Engineer BiMOS Backend - Assembly 80 - 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The opportunity As a global leader in power semiconductor technology, we offer one of the most diverse product portfolios in the industry. Our products include thyristors, diodes, gate turn-off thyristors, integrated gate-commutated thyristors, insulated-gate bipolar transistors, and metal–oxide–semiconductor field-effect transistors. These components are trusted across sectors such as power transmission and distribution, mobility, and renewable energy for their exceptional quality and reliability. In the role of Process Engineer for BiMOS Backend, you will contribute to the advancement of our automated power module production. You'll have the opportunity to improve existing manufacturing processes and lead innovative development projects, with a particular focus on automated chip assembly and soldering. How you'll make an impact Improve the capability of chip attach processes through the application of statistical methods and design of experiments Analyse production data to enhance process performance, identify long-term trends, and support the prevention of potential failures Lead the optimization of automated production systems to improve manufacturing capacity, stability, and quality Support troubleshooting and root cause analysis activities to sustain and improve production throughput Contribute to new product development by shaping production processes and supporting the successful transition to volume manufacturing Your background A master's degree in industrial, mechanical, electrical, or chemical engineering, or a related field Several years of experience in an automated production environment Solid machine-vision and automated inspection skills, as well as experience in Pick and Place processes Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, a quality-focused mindset, and a proactive, hands-on approach Familiarity with DoE, data analysis, Six Sigma methodologies, and production statistics is a plus Proficiency in both German and English More about us Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

jobs.title: Photolithography Process Engineer 80 – 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The opportunity Join a high performing photolithography team where your expertise truly makes an impact. As a Senior Photolithography Engineer, you will be responsible for developing and optimizing photolithography processes used in semiconductor manufacturing. Your role will involve working with advanced lithography equipment, collaborating with cross-functional teams, and ensuring high-quality production standards. This is your opportunity to shape technical decisions, contribute to long term tool strategies, and drive meaningful improvements in stability, uptime, and process performance. Are you someone who takes ownership, thrives in a fast-paced environment, and enjoys making a real impact? Then apply today! How you'll make an impact Ensure processes meet the production program and yield goals and address any product yield and rework issues. Engage with equipment and material vendors to develop new solutions and improve existing processes, to ensure smooth functioning of the production line. Develop new techniques, modify existing designs, and coordinate process improvement projects. Analyze process data to identify trends, optimize performance, and troubleshoot issues (implement and regularly check SPC). Independent planning and Implementation of new machinery into the production line. Work closely with process integration, wet etch, diffusion, metals, dry etch, and implant teams to ensure seamless production. Supports some metrology tools i.e. to measure CD and Overlay. On-call duties on weekends and public holidays (as required from the production) with participation in the on-call meeting (before the on-call duty) agreed on his own responsibility with the other on-call service providers. Your background Bachelor's degree in a related field (e.g., Electrical, Mechanical, Chemical, Materials Science or Physics) with 5+ years of experience in industry or master's degree with 3+ years of experience in industry or Ph.D. with industry experience Extensive experience in wafer photolithography operations especially in coating and exposure in Steppers, in a wafer manufacturing environment (thin-film-head, semiconductor wafer manufacturing) Familiarity with automated wafer factory software systems like SPC, MES and Experience with data extraction, manipulation, and analysis Strong understanding of optics and immersion lithography Proficiency in data science and programming is preferred Good English and German language skills Ability to work in a cleanroom environment More about us Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

Descrizione - L'opportunità Unisciti a un team di fotolitografia ad alte prestazioni in cui la tua esperienza fa davvero un impatto. - In qualità di Senior Photolithography Engineer, sarai responsabile dello sviluppo e dell'ottimizzazione dei processi fotolitici utilizzati nella produzione di semiconduttori. - Il tuo ruolo sarà quello di lavorare con apparecchiature di litografia avanzate, collaborando con team interfunzionali e garantendo standard di produzione di alta qualità. - Questa è la vostra opportunità di modellare le decisioni tecniche, contribuire a strategie di utensili a lungo termine, e guidare miglioramenti significativi in termini di stabilità, uptime e prestazioni di processo. Sei qualcuno che prende la proprieta', prospera in un ambiente frenetico e si diverte a fare un vero impatto? Allora applica oggi! Mansioni - Corso di laurea in un campo correlato (ad esempio, elettrico, meccanico, chimico, scienza dei materiali o fisica) con 5+ anni di esperienza nell'industria o master con 3+ anni di esperienza nell'industria o nel dottorato con esperienza nel settore - Ampia esperienza nelle operazioni di fotolitografia wafer, in particolare nel rivestimento e nell'esposizione in Steppers, in un ambiente di produzione di wafer (produzione di ondulazioni a testa di film, semiconduttore) - Familiarità con sistemi software di fabbrica di wafer automatizzati come SPC, MES e Experience con estrazione, manipolazione e analisi dei dati - Forte comprensione dell'ottica e della litografia di immersione - La competenza nella scienza dei dati e nella programmazione è preferita - Buone competenze linguistiche in inglese e tedesco - Capacità di lavorare in un ambiente pulito
• Requisiti - Impegnarsi con attrezzature e fornitori di materiali per sviluppare nuove soluzioni e migliorare i processi esistenti, per garantire un buon funzionamento della linea di produzione. - Sviluppare nuove tecniche, modificare i progetti esistenti e coordinare i progetti di miglioramento del processo. - Analizzare i dati del processo per identificare le tendenze, ottimizzare le prestazioni e risolvere i problemi (attuazione e controllare regolarmente SPC). - Pianificazione indipendente e realizzazione di nuovi macchinari nella linea di produzione. - Lavorare a stretto contatto con l'integrazione dei processi, l'incisione bagnata, la diffusione, i metalli, l'incisione secca e i team di impianti per garantire la produzione senza soluzione di continuità. - Supporta alcuni strumenti di metrologia per misurare CD e Overlay. - Obblighi di invio nei fine settimana e nei giorni festivi (come richiesto dalla produzione) con partecipazione alla riunione on-call (prima dell'obbligo di invio) concordato sulla sua responsabilità con gli altri fornitori di servizi on-call.
