descriptionByLocale.de: Die Chance Sind Sie bestrebt, durch die Leitung komplexer, hochwertiger Projekte globale Wirkung zu erzielen? Kombinieren Sie strategisches Denken mit starken Umsetzungsfähigkeiten? Innerhalb der Hochspannungsproduktgruppe von Hitachi Energy gestalten wir die Zukunft der Stromübertragung und -verteilung. In unserem globalen Geschäft für gasisolierte Schaltanlagen (GIS) mit Sitz in Zürich-Oerlikon liefern wir fortschrittliche Lösungen mit den höchsten Standards an Zuverlässigkeit und Innovation. Wir suchen einen erfahrenen Projektmanager, der strategisch wichtige Projekte in einer globalen Matrixorganisation übernimmt. Sie leiten funktionsübergreifende Teams über Regionen hinweg, fungieren als wichtige Schnittstelle zu internationalen Kunden, treiben die erfolgreiche Projektabwicklung voran und tragen gleichzeitig zur kontinuierlichen Verbesserung und langfristigen Wertschöpfung bei. So können Sie etwas bewirken: Führen Sie die End-to-End-Ausführung komplexer, internationaler Projekte von der kommerziellen Übergabe bis zum erfolgreichen Abschluss und stellen Sie sicher, dass die Ziele in Bezug auf Umfang, Zeitrahmen, Qualität und Finanzen erfüllt werden. Fungieren Sie als primäre Schnittstelle zu globalen Kunden, bauen Sie vertrauensvolle Beziehungen auf und leiten Sie wirkungsvolle Projekte, einschließlich technischer Gespräche und Werksabnahmetests. Fördern Sie ein proaktives Risiko- und Chancenmanagement und wenden Sie eine strategische Denkweise an, um nachhaltige Projektergebnisse sicherzustellen. Behalten Sie die volle Verantwortung für die Projektleistung, einschließlich Finanzsteuerung, Ressourcenplanung und Prognosen in enger Abstimmung mit der Steuerung. Leiten Sie den Vertrag Ausführung, einschließlich Änderungs- und Anspruchsmanagement, unter Wahrung der Kundenzufriedenheit und der Geschäftsinteressen. Förderung der funktionsübergreifenden Zusammenarbeit und Abstimmung zwischen den Entwicklungs-, Fertigungs- und Lieferkettenteams in einem globalen Umfeld. Tragen Sie zu kontinuierlichen Verbesserungsinitiativen bei und gestalten Sie aktiv Best Practices innerhalb der Projektmanagementfunktion. Ihr Hintergrund. Nachgewiesene Erfolgsbilanz (7+ Jahre) bei der Leitung komplexer Projekte in einem industriellen oder technologieorientierten Umfeld, idealerweise mit internationaler Präsenz. Nachgewiesene Fähigkeit, Stakeholder auf mehreren Ebenen zu führen, einschließlich leitender Kundenvertreter und interner Führung. Starkes kaufmännisches Verständnis mit solider Expertise in Finanzsteuerung, Risikomanagement und Vertragsabwicklung Sicherer Kommunikator mit der Fähigkeit, in einem internationalen Kontext Einfluss zu nehmen, zu verhandeln und effektiv zu präsentieren Erfahrung in der Arbeit in Matrixorganisationen und der Führung interkultureller Teams Relevante Projektmanagement-Zertifizierungen (z. B. PMP, IPMA) sind von Vorteil. Fließende Deutsch- oder Französischkenntnisse; Verhandlungssichere Englischkenntnisse sind obligatorisch. Mehr über uns Unsere flexiblen Arbeitspraktiken helfen Ihnen, Ihre persönliche und geschäftliche Leistung zu optimieren und gleichzeitig ein Umfeld zu schaffen, in dem alle Mitarbeiter ihre Fähigkeiten entwickeln und wachsen können.
descriptionByLocale.fr: L'opportunité Êtes-vous déterminé à créer un impact mondial grâce à la direction de projets complexes et de grande valeur ? Combinez-vous réflexion stratégique et fortes capacités d’exécution ? Au sein du groupe de produits haute tension d'Hitachi Energy, nous façonnons l'avenir du transport et de la distribution d'énergie. Dans notre activité mondiale d'appareillage à isolation gazeuse (GIS), basée à Zürich-Oerlikon, nous proposons des solutions avancées répondant aux normes les plus élevées de fiabilité et d'innovation. Nous recherchons un chef de projet expérimenté pour prendre en charge des projets stratégiquement importants dans une organisation matricielle mondiale. Vous dirigerez des équipes interfonctionnelles dans toutes les régions, agirez en tant qu'interface clé avec les clients internationaux et piloterez la réussite des projets tout en contribuant à l'amélioration continue et à la création de valeur à long terme. Comment vous aurez un impact Diriger l'exécution de bout en bout de projets internationaux complexes, depuis le transfert commercial jusqu'à la clôture réussie, en garantissant la livraison dans le respect des objectifs de portée, de calendrier, de qualité et financiers. Agir en tant qu'interface principale avec les clients mondiaux, en établissant des relations de confiance et en dirigeant des engagements à fort impact, y compris des discussions techniques et des tests d'acceptation en usine. Piloter une gestion proactive des risques et des opportunités, en appliquant un état d'esprit stratégique pour garantir des résultats de projet durables. Maintenir l'entière responsabilité de la performance du projet, y compris la direction financière, la planification des ressources et les prévisions en étroite adéquation avec le contrôle. sauvegarder à la fois la satisfaction des clients et les intérêts commerciaux Favoriser la collaboration et l'alignement interfonctionnels entre les équipes d'ingénierie, de fabrication et de chaîne d'approvisionnement dans une configuration mondiale Contribuer aux initiatives d'amélioration continue et façonner activement les meilleures pratiques au sein de la fonction de gestion de projet Votre expérience Expérience avérée (7 ans et plus) dans la gestion de projets complexes dans un environnement industriel ou technologique, idéalement avec une exposition internationale Capacité démontrée à diriger des parties prenantes à plusieurs niveaux, y compris des représentants seniors des clients et la direction interne Fort sens commercial avec une solide expertise en pilotage financier, en gestion des risques et en exécution de contrats Communicateur confiant avec la capacité de influencer, négocier et présenter efficacement dans un contexte international Expérience de travail dans des organisations matricielles et de direction d'équipes interculturelles Certifications pertinentes en gestion de projet (par exemple, PMP, IPMA) sont un avantage Maîtrise de l'allemand ou du français ; affaires, la maîtrise de l'anglais est obligatoire. En savoir plus sur nous Nos pratiques de travail flexibles vous aident à optimiser vos performances personnelles et professionnelles tout en créant un environnement dans lequel tous les employés peuvent développer leurs compétences et évoluer.

jobs.title: Industrial Engineer high Voltage and Production Developer 50% (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
The opportunity Join our Industrial Engineering team, where team members work within two clearly differentiated focus areas: production development and industrial engineering. Each role has a defined main focus in one of these domains, while both profiles collaborate closely within the same team and contribute to shared production goals. Depending on your background, you will take ownership of one focus area while staying connected to the broader engineering activities. You will work hands‑on with production, engineering, and suppliers in a highly collaborative environment. This setup allows you to deepen your expertise while understanding adjacent processes. You will grow through real shopfloor impact, responsibility, and cross‑functional collaboration. How you'll make an impact Develop and optimize production equipment and processes Design mechanical components tools and technical solutions Support industrialization of new products and manufacturing concepts Improve efficiency quality and cost across production Develop and optimize high voltage production processes Analyze and solve electrical and technical production issues Ensure safe and compliant manufacturing concepts Collaborate with engineering quality and suppliers Your background Degree in mechanical or electrical engineering or similar field Solid understanding of mechanical or electrical systems Experience with technical drawings schematics or CAD tools Structured independent and solution‑oriented working style Strong analytical thinking and problem‑solving skills Good communication skills in a technical environment More about us We are a technology-driven company with a strong focus on innovation, continuous improvement, and sustainable manufacturing. 
• We offer flexible working conditions, dedicated mentorship, and a supportive, inclusive environment where you can grow personally and professionally – empowering you to thrive while balancing life and work.

jobs.title: R&D Electrical Validation Engineer 80 - 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
The opportunity   In our Product evaluation and qualification team at Hitachi Energy Semiconductors in Lenzburg, we make sure to get to the bottom of things and deliver faultless robust semiconductor chips and power modules through a rigorous qualification process. Our products are delivered to a wide range of customers worldwide for different industrial applications as well as renewable energy, traction, and eMobility. For the extension and strengthening of our testing activities, we look for a highly motivated  R&D Electrical Validation Engineer.   How you'll make an impact   Contribute to development projects for next-generation semiconductor chips and power modules Collaborate with R&D design, process, and product engineering teams Evaluate the performance of new platforms through electrical testing Execute and monitor various electrical tests to ensure product quality Analyze test data and provide technical recommendations Write and review test reports to communicate the key findings to project stakeholders Contribute to continuous improvement of testing activities for customer satisfaction Adhere to safety rules, environmental protection, and laboratory cleanliness and order Your background     Master's degree, or PhD in electrical engineering or a related field with a focus on semiconductor devices or power electronics Few years of experience in electrical engineering, preferably in an R&D environment. Solid understanding of electrical engineering principles, circuit design, and analysis. Familiarity with CAD software for electrical design (e.g., Altium Designer, Eagle, KiCad). Experience with laboratory equipment such as oscilloscopes, multimeters, and power supplies. Proficiency in modern software tools (Python, LabView, CAD software, statistical data analysis tools) Fluency in English (written and spoken) More about us We are a technology-driven company with a strong focus on innovation, continuous improvement, and sustainable manufacturing. 
• We offer flexible working conditions, dedicated mentorship, and a supportive, inclusive environment where you can grow personally and professionally – empowering you to thrive while balancing life and work.

jobs.title: Senior Quality Engineer 80 – 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
The opportunity     Hitachi Energy is a global leader in power and renewable technologies that enable utility and industry customers to improve their performance while lowering environmental impact. CHSEM provides high‑power semiconductor devices to Hitachi Energy internal customers (e.g. HVDC, GPQSS) as well as to external customers. The Senior Material Quality Engineer ensures the quality, robustness, and long‑term reliability of critical raw materials used in BiMOS semiconductor device production at the Lenzburg fabrication facility. Acting as a technical authority, the role independently manages complex material‑ and supplier‑related quality topics, contributes to supplier quality strategy, and supports both supplier and team capability development to enable stable and scalable operations. H ow you'll make an impact   Drive the material quality approach for critical raw materials used in BiMOS operations Define and continuously improve CTQ concepts and control strategies Lead complex material quality investigations related to deviations, yield, and reliability issues Monitor & develop supplier performance and ensure effective implementation of corrective actions Lead material qualification, requalification, and change management activities Support production with technical expertise during production, troubleshooting, and ramp-up phases Drive cross-functional improvement initiatives to enhance quality, reliability, and cost efficiency Act as a technical reference, supporting or mentoring engineers and strengthening supplier and team capabilities   Your background   Bachelor's or Master's degree in Materials Science, Chemistry, Physics, or a related field Minimum 5 years of experience in material quality, supplier quality, or semiconductor manufacturing Certified auditor (VDA 6.3, ISO 19011, or equivalent) Strong knowledge of material quality, process control, and risk management in a manufacturing environment Proven ability to independently manage complex material and supplier quality issues Experience with structured quality methods such as 8D, Six Sigma, or equivalent More about us   
• We offer you: Extra days off between Christmas and New Year  Subsidised meals at the locations with canteens 50% discount on main courses at our FELFEL fridges Discount on memberships at various fitness centres  Discounts on various products and services Attractive pension benefits with our company pension fund   Diversity: Promotion of diversity and inclusion and cultural offers, credit cards, petrol, etc.)

The Senior Material Quality Engineer ensures the quality, robustness, and long‑term reliability of critical raw materials used in BiMOS semiconductor device production at the Lenzburg fabrication facility. Acting as a technical authority, the role independently manages complex material‑ and supplier‑related quality topics, contributes to supplier quality strategy, and supports both supplier and team capability development to enable stable and scalable operations. H ow you'll make an impact Drive the material quality approach for critical raw materials used in BiMOS operations Define and continuously improve CTQ concepts and control strategies Lead complex material quality investigations related to deviations, yield, and reliability issues Monitor & develop supplier performance and ensure effective implementation of corrective actions Lead material qualification, requalification, and change management activities Support production with technical expertise during production, troubleshooting, and ramp-up phases Drive cross-functional improvement initiatives to enhance quality, reliability, and cost efficiency Act as a technical reference, supporting or mentoring engineers and strengthening supplier and team capabilities Your background Bachelor's or Master's degree in Materials Science, Chemistry, Physics, or a related field Minimum 5 years of experience in material quality, supplier quality, or semiconductor manufacturing Certified auditor (VDA 6.3, ISO 19011, or equivalent) Strong knowledge of material quality, process control, and risk management in a manufacturing environment Proven ability to independently manage complex material and supplier quality issues Experience with structured quality methods such as 8D, Six Sigma, or equivalent More about us

jobs.description:
Über die Position Als weltweit führender Anbieter von Leistungshalbleitern bietet Hitachi Energy eines der vielfältigsten Produktportfolios. Darunter; Thyristoren, Dioden, Gate-Turn-Off-Thyristoren (GTOs), Integrated Gate-Commutated Thyristors (IGCTs), Insulated Gate Bipolar Transistors (IGBTs) und MOSFETs -, die in Industrie, Energieübertragung und -verteilung, Mobilität und erneuerbaren Energien für ihre hohe Qualität und Zuverlässigkeit geschätzt werden. Für unser Team suchen wir befristet eine\/n Automatiker\/in, der\/die beim Aufbau und der Inbetriebnahme unserer Leistungshalbleiter-Testsysteme mitwirkt. Das kannst du bewirken Aufbau von Leistungshalbleiter-Testsystemen inklusive Mechanik, Elektrik, Pneumatik und Hydraulik Durchführung von Anpassungsarbeiten an fehlerhaften Konstruktionen, Fertigungsteilen oder Schemen Kontrolle aller mechanischen, pneumatischen, elektrischen, programmierten und hydraulischen Funktionen Durchführung von Erdungsmessungen (Überprüfung der Durchgängigkeit des Schutzleitersystems nach EN 60204-1 18b) Erstellen von Inbetriebnahme- und Isolationskoordinationsprotokollen Durchführung der Inbetriebnahme und Isolationskoordination von Testsystemen Sicherstellung der Einhaltung von Qualitäts-, Sicherheits- und Normvorgaben Aktive Mitarbeit bei der Optimierung von Prozessen und Systemen Das bringst du mit Abgeschlossene Ausbildung als Automatiker\/in EFZ (evtl. mit höherer Fachschule), idealerweise mit Berufserfahrung in der Montage Erfahrung im Projektmanagement Fundiertes Know-how in der mechanischen Bearbeitung von Materialien (Drehen, Fräsen, Bohren, Sägen etc.) Vertrautheit mit Leistungshalbleitern, Messtechnik sowie relevanten Richtlinien und Normen Sicherer Umgang mit Office 365 Sehr gute Deutsch- und gute Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift Mehr über uns Befristete Position in einem international führenden Hightech-Unternehmen Abwechslungsreiche und verantwortungsvolle 
• Aufgaben im Bereich Leistungshalbleiter Offene Unternehmenskultur mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen Attraktive Sozialleistungen und moderne Arbeitsmittel

Informazioni sulla posizione In qualità di fornitore leader a livello mondiale di semiconduttori di potenza, Hitachi Energy offre uno dei portafogli di prodotti più diversificati. Compreso; Tiristori, diodi, tiristori di spegnimento (GTO), tiristori con commutazione di gate integrati (IGCT), transistor bipolari con gate isolato (IGBT) e MOSFET, apprezzati per la loro alta qualità e affidabilità nell'industria, nella trasmissione e distribuzione di energia, nella mobilità e nelle energie rinnovabili.
• Cerchiamo un tecnico temporaneo dell'automazione per il nostro team che sarà coinvolto nella configurazione e nella messa in servizio dei nostri sistemi di test sui semiconduttori di potenza. Questo è quello che puoi fare Configurare sistemi di test di semiconduttori di potenza, inclusi quelli meccanici, elettrici, pneumatici e idraulici Eseguire lavori di regolazione su progetti, parti di produzione o schemi difettosi Controllare tutte le funzioni meccaniche, pneumatiche, elettriche, programmate e idrauliche Effettuare misurazioni di messa a terra (controllo della continuità del sistema di conduttori di protezione secondo EN 60204-1 18b) Creare protocolli di messa in servizio e coordinamento dell'isolamento Effettuare il coordinamento di messa in servizio e isolamento dei sistemi di prova Garantire il rispetto dei requisiti di qualità, sicurezza e standard Attivo partecipazione all'ottimizzazione di processi e sistemi Cosa portate con voi Formazione completata come ingegnere dell'automazione EFZ (possibilmente. con una scuola tecnica superiore), preferibilmente con esperienza professionale nel settore dell'assemblaggio Esperienza nella gestione di progetti Solido know-how nella lavorazione meccanica dei materiali (tornitura, fresatura, foratura, segatura, ecc.) Conoscenza dei semiconduttori di potenza, della tecnologia di misurazione nonché delle linee guida e degli standard pertinenti Utilizzo sicuro di Office 365 Ottima conoscenza della lingua tedesca scritta e parlata e buona conoscenza dell'inglese Maggiori informazioni su di noi Posizione temporanea in un'azienda leader internazionale nel settore high-tech Compiti vari e responsabili nel campo dei semiconduttori di potenza Cultura aziendale aperta con processi decisionali brevi, prestazioni sociali interessanti e attrezzature di lavoro moderne
descriptionByLocale.en:
About the position As the world's leading supplier of power semiconductors, Hitachi Energy offers one of the most diverse product portfolios. Including; Thyristors, diodes, gate turn-off thyristors (GTOs), integrated gate-commutated thyristors (IGCTs), insulated gate bipolar transistors (IGBTs) and MOSFETs - which are valued for their high quality and reliability in industry, power transmission and distribution, mobility and renewable energy. We are looking for a temporary automation technician for our team who will be involved in setting up and commissioning our power semiconductor test systems. This is what you can do Setting up power semiconductor test systems including mechanics, electrics, pneumatics and hydraulics Carrying out adjustment work on faulty designs, production parts or schemes Checking all mechanical, pneumatic, electrical, programmed and hydraulic functions Carrying out grounding measurements (checking the continuity of the protective conductor system according to EN 60204-1 18b) Creating commissioning and insulation coordination protocols Carrying out commissioning and isolation coordination of test systems Ensuring compliance with quality, safety and standard requirements Active participation in the optimization of processes and systems What you bring with you Completed training as an automation engineer EFZ (possibly. with a higher technical college), ideally with professional experience in assembly Experience in project management Sound know-how in the mechanical processing of materials (turning, milling, drilling, sawing, etc.) Familiarity with power semiconductors, measurement technology as well as relevant guidelines and standards Confident use of Office 365 Very good written and spoken German and good English skills More about us Temporary position in a leading international high-tech company Varied and responsible
• tasks in the field of power semiconductors Open Corporate culture with short decision-making processes, attractive social benefits and modern work equipment

descriptionByLocale.fr: À propos du poste En tant que premier fournisseur mondial de semi-conducteurs de puissance, Hitachi Energy propose l'un des portefeuilles de produits les plus diversifiés. Y compris; Thyristors, diodes, thyristors à commutation de grille (GTO), thyristors à commutation de grille intégrée (IGCT), transistors bipolaires à grille isolée (IGBT) et MOSFET - qui sont appréciés pour leur haute qualité et leur fiabilité dans l'industrie, le transport et la distribution d'énergie, la mobilité et les énergies renouvelables. Nous recherchons pour notre équipe un technicien en automation temporaire qui sera impliqué dans la mise en place et la mise en service de nos systèmes de tests de semi-conducteurs de puissance. C'est ce que vous pouvez faire Mettre en place des systèmes de test de semi-conducteurs de puissance, y compris mécaniques, électriques, pneumatiques et hydrauliques Effectuer des travaux de réglage sur des conceptions, des pièces ou des schémas de production défectueux Vérifier toutes les fonctions mécaniques, pneumatiques, électriques, programmées et hydrauliques Effectuer des mesures de mise à la terre (vérifier la continuité du système de conducteurs de protection selon EN 60204-1 18b) Créer des protocoles de mise en service et de coordination d'isolation Effectuer la coordination de mise en service et d'isolement des systèmes de test Assurer le respect des exigences de qualité, de sécurité et des normes Participation active à l'optimisation des processus et des systèmes Ce que vous apportez Une formation complétée en tant qu'ingénieur en automatisation EFZ (éventuellement. avec une école technique supérieure), idéalement avec une expérience professionnelle dans le montage Expérience en gestion de projet Solide savoir-faire dans le traitement mécanique des matériaux (tournage, fraisage, perçage, sciage, etc.) Familiarité avec les semi-conducteurs de puissance, la technologie de mesure ainsi que les directives et normes pertinentes Utilisation sûre d'Office 365 Très bonnes compétences en allemand écrit et oral et bonne anglais En savoir plus sur nous Poste temporaire dans une entreprise internationale de haute technologie de premier plan Tâches variées et responsables dans le domaine des semi-conducteurs de puissance Ouvert Culture d'entreprise avec des processus de décision courts, attrayant avantages sociaux et équipements de travail modernes

jobs.title: HR Employee Lifecycle & Immigration Specialist 80 - 100% (f/m/d) - 12-month contract
jobs.description: The opportunity We are looking for a proactive and fast-learning HR Operations Specialist to temporarily join our team and support the Employee Lifecycle & Immigration processes.  This is a temporary position for 12 months and requires someone who can quickly adapt, take ownership, and deliver high-quality service in a dynamic, international environment. How you'll make an impact Manage and execute immigration processes for local hires and business travel, handling all types of work and residence permits from start to finish Ensure compliance with Swiss immigration regulations and internal procedures Provide high-level HR Operations support to HR colleagues, business managers, and employees, ensuring timely and accurate processing aligned with our Service Level Agreements Act as a point of contact for HR-related inquiries, offering clear and concise guidance on policies and procedures Handle activities across the Employee Lifecycle, including onboarding, changes, and offboarding Identify and suggest improvements based on feedback and operational experience Participate in process improvement projects and collaborate closely across HR Operations, HR Functions, and HR Business Partners Your background You hold a Swiss federal vocational certificate in HR or equivalent further education, ideally with a focus on immigration or HR Operations Minimum 2 years of experience in an international environment, ideally in immigration or HR Operations Solid understanding of Swiss labor law and immigration procedures Proficient in Microsoft Office; experience with Workday and ticketing tools is a plus Strong analytical skills and attention to detail Ability to prioritize tasks effectively and meet deadlines Excellent communication skills, customer service orientation, and a resilient, flexible mindset A team player who works independently and takes initiative Fluent in German and English; Italian or French is a plus More about us Our flexible work practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

jobs.title: Product Engineer – Power Semiconductors Module Packaging (BiMOS) 80 – 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The opportunity As a Product Engineer, you will be a core member of the BiMOS Product Engineering Team, playing a key role at the interface of manufacturing, R&D, and quality. Based in Lenzburg, Switzerland, you will take end-to-end ownership of a product platform and drive its optimization using advanced data analysis and continuous improvement methods. Your work will directly impact product quality, yield, and cost competitiveness in high power semiconductor manufacturing. How you'll make an impact Monitor, analyze, and interpret yield and quality data to identify improvement opportunities and drive sustainable enhancements in cost, quality, and yield Lead and execute improvement projects using methodologies such as Six Sigma, Lean Manufacturing, 8D, and related frameworks Take full product ownership after R&D handover, including coordination and monitoring of new product ramp up in the fabrication line Perform root cause analysis and troubleshooting of product defects, weaknesses, and quality issues, deriving clear conclusions on process and design gaps Maintain, enhance, and implement data acquisition, analytics, and reporting methods to support data driven decision making Support process and R&D engineers with strong technical expertise and structured problem-solving approaches Your background Master's degree or PhD in Physics, Electrical Engineering, or a related discipline Strong expertise in statistical analysis, problem solving methodologies, and advanced data analysis techniques Semiconductor manufacturing experience is an advantage Proven experience leading complex improvement projects, ideally with small, cross functional teams Comfortable working in an international, matrix organization, with excellent communication and collaboration skills Innovative, quality driven team player with a high willingness to learn and take ownership Very good command of German and English (written and spoken, B2\/C1 level) More about us Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

descriptionByLocale.it: L'opportunità In qualità di Product Engineer, sarai un membro fondamentale del team di ingegneria del prodotto BiMOS, giocando un ruolo chiave nell'interfaccia di produzione, R&D e qualità. Con sede a Lenzburg, Svizzera, si prende la proprietà end-to-end di una piattaforma di prodotto e la sua ottimizzazione utilizzando l'analisi avanzata dei dati e metodi di miglioramento continuo. Il vostro lavoro influenzerà direttamente la qualità del prodotto, la resa e la competitività dei costi nella produzione di semiconduttori ad alta potenza. Come farete un impatto Monitorare, analizzare e interpretare i dati di resa e di qualità per identificare le opportunità di miglioramento e promuovere miglioramenti sostenibili nel costo, nella qualità e nel rendimento Prendere la piena proprietà del prodotto dopo R&D handover, tra cui il coordinamento e il monitoraggio di una nuova rampa di prodotto nella linea di fabbricazione Eseguire l'analisi della causa e la risoluzione dei problemi di difetti del prodotto, debolezza e problemi di qualità, derivanti chiare conclusioni sui processi e lacune di progettazione Mantenere, migliorare e implementare l'acquisizione dei dati, analisi e metodi di report per supportare il processo decisionale guidato dai dati e ingegneri R&w con una forte competenza tecnica e metodi di problem-solving Le nostre pratiche di lavoro flessibili ti aiutano a ottimizzare le prestazioni personali e aziendali creando un ambiente in cui tutti i dipendenti possono sviluppare le loro competenze e crescere.

jobs.description:
Die Möglichkeit Zur Verstärkung unserer Front-End-Sales-Organisation suchen wir einen Head of Bid & Proposal, der eine zentrale Rolle im Verkaufsteam Schweiz übernimmt. In dieser Funktion verantworten Sie das Bid Management sowie die Erstellung qualitativ hochwertiger und wettbewerbsfähiger Angebote für unser Portfolio von Hochspannungsprodukten und Transformatoren. Sie entwickeln das Bid-&-Proposal-Team weiter und führen es fachlich wie disziplinarisch. Als zentrale Schnittstelle koordinieren Sie sämtliche relevanten internen Stakeholder und tragen mit termingerechten, qualitativ überzeugenden Angeboten massgeblich zur erfolgreichen Entwicklung des Schweizer Marktes bei. Wir suchen eine unternehmerisch denkende Führungspersönlichkeit mit nachweislicher Erfolgsbilanz in der Zielerreichung und im Aufbau leistungsstarker Teams in einem dynamischen Wachstumsumfeld. Das können Sie bewirken Fachliche und disziplinarische Führung des Bid-&-Proposal- sowie Order-Handling-Teams mit klarer Ausrichtung auf Wachstum und Geschäftsergebnisse im Einklang mit der Hitachi-Energy-Strategie Weiterentwicklung von Kompetenzen, Strukturen und Prozessen zur Sicherstellung eines leistungsfähigen, motivierten und engagierten Teams Gesamtverantwortung für Angebotsprozesse und Auftragsabwicklung im Produktgeschäft für den Schweizer Markt – termingerecht, qualitäts- und kundengerecht Sicherstellung der fristgerechten, korrekten und regelkonformen Angebotsabgabe gemäss Kunden-, Vertrags- und internen 
• Anforderungen Entwicklung und Steuerung von Angebotsstrategien in enger Zusammenarbeit mit Market Management, Area Sales, Key Account Management, Contract Management & Legal sowie den Werken Aktive Gestaltung effizienter Schnittstellen zwischen Vertrieb, Engineering und Produktion sowie kontinuierliche Verbesserung der Angebotsmanagement‑Prozesse Vorleben der Hitachi-Energy-Werte, insbesondere Sicherheit und Integrität Ihr Hintergrund Abgeschlossenes Studium (Bachelor\/Master) im technischen oder ingenieurwissenschaftlichen Bereich; betriebswirtschaftliche Zusatzqualifikation von Vorteil Mindestens 10 Jahre relevante Berufserfahrung im technischen Vertrieb, Bid & Proposal oder Projektmanagement Nachgewiesene Erfahrung in der Führung oder Koordination von Teams sowie im Management komplexer Stakeholder‑Strukturen Branchenkenntnisse im Energiesektor sowie ausgeprägte Kundenorientierung Tiefes Verständnis von Ausschreibungs‑ und Auftragsabwicklungsprozessen, inkl. SAP‑Grundlagen, kaufmännischer Abläufe, Vertragsverhandlungen, Risiko‑ sowie Claims‑Management Sehr gute Kommunikationsfähigkeit, eigenständige und proaktive Arbeitsweise, Team-Player Verhandlungssicheres Deutsch sowie sehr gutes Englisch in Wort und Schrift; Französisch oder Italienisch von Vorteil Mehr über uns Abwechslungsreiche und verantwortungsvolle Tätigkeit in einem dynamischen, engagierten und kollaborativen Umfeld Klare Förderung Ihrer fachlichen und persönlichen Weiterentwicklung durch strukturierte Lern- und Entwicklungsangebote Eine Unternehmenskultur, die Zusammenarbeit, Vielfalt und unterschiedliche Perspektiven wertschätzt Eine einzigartige Kultur: Bringen Sie Ihre Persönlichkeit, Ihre Leidenschaft und Ihre Ideen ein und gestalten Sie mit uns eine nachhaltige Energiezukunft Flexible Arbeitsmodelle inkl. descriptionByLocale.it:
L'opportunità Per rafforzare la nostra organizzazione di vendita front-end, stiamo cercando un responsabile Bid & Proposal che assumerà un ruolo centrale nel team di vendita svizzero. In questo ruolo sarai responsabile della gestione delle offerte e della creazione di offerte competitive e di alta qualità per il nostro portafoglio di prodotti e trasformatori ad alta tensione. Svilupperai ulteriormente il team di offerte e proposte e lo guiderai sia a livello professionale che disciplinare. In qualità di interfaccia centrale, coordini tutti gli stakeholder interni rilevanti e fornisci un contributo significativo allo sviluppo di successo del mercato svizzero con offerte tempestive e di alta qualità.
• Cerchiamo un leader imprenditoriale con una comprovata esperienza nel raggiungimento degli obiettivi e nella creazione di team ad alte prestazioni in un ambiente di crescita dinamico. Questo è ciò che puoi ottenere Leadership professionale e disciplinata del team di gestione offerte e proposte e ordini con un chiaro focus sulla crescita e sui risultati aziendali in linea con la strategia Hitachi Energy Ulteriore sviluppo di competenze, strutture e processi per garantire un team ad alte prestazioni, motivato e impegnato Responsabilità generale dei processi di offerta e di elaborazione degli ordini nel business dei prodotti per il mercato svizzero - puntuale, di qualità e in linea con il cliente Garantire la consegna corretta e puntuale e la presentazione conforme delle offerte in conformità con i requisiti del cliente, contrattuali e interni Sviluppo e controllo dell'offerta strategie in stretta collaborazione con Market Management, Area Sales, Key Account Management, Contract Management & Legal nonché gli stabilimenti Progettazione attiva di interfacce efficienti tra vendite, ingegneria e produzione nonché miglioramento continuo dei processi di gestione dell'offerta Vivere i valori Hitachi Energy, in particolare sicurezza e integrità Il tuo background Studi completati (Bachelor/Master) in campo tecnico o ingegneristico; Ulteriori qualifiche aziendali sono un vantaggio Almeno 10 anni di esperienza professionale rilevante nelle vendite tecniche, nella gestione di offerte e proposte o di progetti Comprovata esperienza nella guida o nel coordinamento di team, nonché nella gestione di strutture complesse di stakeholder Conoscenza del settore nel settore energetico e forte orientamento al cliente Profonda conoscenza dei processi di gara e di elaborazione degli ordini, incl. Nozioni di base di SAP, processi commerciali, trattative contrattuali, gestione dei rischi e dei sinistri Ottime capacità di comunicazione, modo di lavorare indipendente e proattivo, giocatore di squadra Tedesco fluente negli affari e ottimo inglese parlato e scritto; Il francese o l'italiano sono un vantaggio Maggiori informazioni su di noi Lavoro vario e responsabile in un ambiente dinamico, impegnato e collaborativo Chiaro supporto per il tuo sviluppo professionale e personale attraverso offerte strutturate di apprendimento e sviluppo Una cultura aziendale che valorizza la collaborazione, la diversità e le diverse prospettive Una cultura unica: porta la tua personalità, la tua passione e le tue idee e plasma con noi un futuro energetico sostenibile Modelli di lavoro flessibili che includono opzioni ibride e remote Pacchetto retributivo e benefit attraente e competitivo
descriptionByLocale.en:
The opportunity To strengthen our front-end sales organization, we are looking for a Head of Bid & Proposal to take on a central role in the Swiss sales team. In this role, you will be responsible for bid management and the creation of high-quality and competitive offers for our portfolio of high-voltage products and transformers. You will further develop the Bid & Proposal team and lead it both professionally and disciplinarily. As a central interface, you coordinate all relevant internal stakeholders and make a significant contribution to the successful development of the Swiss market with timely, high-quality offers. We are looking for an entrepreneurial leader with a proven track record of achieving goals and building high-performing teams in a dynamic growth environment. This is what you can achieve Professional and disciplinary leadership of the bid & proposal and order handling team with a clear focus on growth and business results in line with the Hitachi Energy strategy Further development of competencies, structures and processes to ensure a high-performance, motivated and committed team Overall responsibility for offer processes and order processing in the product business for the Swiss market - on time, quality and in line with the customer Ensuring the correct and on-time delivery and compliant submission of offers in accordance with customer, contractual and internal
• requirements Development and control of offer strategies in close collaboration with Market Management, Area Sales, Key Account Management, Contract Management & Legal as well as the plants Active design of efficient interfaces between sales, engineering and production as well as continuous improvement of offer management processes Living the Hitachi Energy values, in particular safety and integrity Your background Completed studies (Bachelor/Master) in the technical or engineering field; Additional business qualifications are an advantage At least 10 years of relevant professional experience in technical sales, bid & proposal or project management Proven experience in leading or coordinating teams as well as in managing complex stakeholder structures Industry knowledge in the energy sector and strong customer orientation Deep understanding of tendering and order processing processes, incl. SAP basics, commercial processes, contract negotiations, risk and claims management Very good communication skills, independent and proactive way of working, team player Business fluent German and very good spoken and written English; French or Italian is an advantage More about us Varied and responsible work in a dynamic, committed and collaborative environment Clear support for your professional and personal development through structured learning and development offers A corporate culture that values collaboration, diversity and different perspectives A unique culture: Bring in your personality, your passion and your ideas and shape a sustainable energy future with us Flexible working models including hybrid and remote options Attractive, competitive Compensation and benefits package

descriptionByLocale.fr:
L'opportunité Pour renforcer notre organisation commerciale front-end, nous recherchons un responsable Bid & Proposal pour assumer un rôle central dans l'équipe commerciale suisse. Dans ce rôle, vous serez responsable de la gestion des offres et de la création d'offres de haute qualité et compétitives pour notre portefeuille de produits et transformateurs haute tension. Vous développerez davantage l’équipe Bid & Proposal et la dirigerez à la fois professionnellement et disciplinairement. En tant qu'interface centrale, vous coordonnez toutes les parties prenantes internes concernées et apportez une contribution significative au développement réussi du marché suisse avec des offres ponctuelles et de haute qualité. Nous recherchons un leader entrepreneurial ayant fait ses preuves en matière d’atteinte d’objectifs et de constitution d’équipes performantes dans un environnement de croissance dynamique. C'est ce que vous pouvez réaliser Leadership professionnel et disciplinaire de l'équipe de traitement des offres et des commandes avec un accent clair sur la croissance et les résultats commerciaux conformément à la stratégie d'Hitachi Energy Développement ultérieur des compétences, des structures et des processus pour garantir une équipe performante, motivée et engagée Responsabilité globale des processus d'offre et du traitement des commandes dans le secteur des produits pour le marché suisse - dans les délais, la qualité et en accord avec le client Assurer la livraison correcte et dans les délais et la soumission conforme des offres conformément aux exigences du client, contractuelles et internes
• Développement et contrôle des stratégies d'offre en étroite collaboration collaboration avec la direction du marché, les ventes de zone, la gestion des comptes clés, la gestion des contrats et le service juridique ainsi qu'avec les usines Conception active d'interfaces efficaces entre les ventes, l'ingénierie et la production ainsi que l'amélioration continue des processus de gestion des offres Vivre les valeurs d'Hitachi Energy, en particulier la sécurité et l'intégrité Votre parcours Études terminées (Bachelor/Master) dans le domaine technique ou d'ingénierie ; Des qualifications commerciales supplémentaires sont un avantage Au moins 10 ans d'expérience professionnelle pertinente dans les ventes techniques, les offres et propositions ou la gestion de projets Expérience avérée dans la direction ou la coordination d'équipes ainsi que dans la gestion de structures de parties prenantes complexes Connaissance du secteur de l'énergie et forte orientation client Compréhension approfondie des processus d'appel d'offres et de traitement des commandes, incl. Bases de SAP, processus commerciaux, négociations contractuelles, gestion des risques et des réclamations. Très bonnes compétences en communication, manière de travailler indépendante et proactive, esprit d'équipe, maîtrise de l'allemand des affaires et très bon anglais parlé et écrit ; Le français ou l'italien est un avantage. En savoir plus sur nous Un travail varié et responsable dans un environnement dynamique, engagé et collaboratif Un soutien clair pour votre développement professionnel et personnel grâce à des offres d'apprentissage et de développement structurées Une culture d'entreprise qui valorise la collaboration, la diversité et les différentes perspectives Une culture unique : Apportez votre personnalité, votre passion et vos idées et façonnez avec nous un avenir énergétique durable Des modèles de travail flexibles comprenant des options hybrides et à distance Un ensemble de rémunération et d'avantages sociaux attrayants et compétitifs
